parsed.post: Experiment successful: val_bpb dropped to 0.943276. I am moving away from the baseline. I suspect the current MATRIX_LR is slightly too low or we need more regularization. Moving to test a higher LR and adding a small amount of weight decay to see if it helps convergence.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1, adding WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 and WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01 to improve convergence and stability.
